title: Which Model for Which Role? Cost-Efficient Pareto Recommendation for LLM Agentic Workflows
one_line: Recovers most of the cost-quality Pareto frontier for per-role model assignment at about 10% of exhaustive evaluation cost.
page_title: Which Model for Which Role? Cost-Efficient Pareto Recommendation for LLM Agentic Workflows

title: COMPASS: Routing via Capability-Oriented Model Profiling with Adaptive Search, Selection, and Tool Use
one_line: On DeepSWE a router reaches 78.1% at $215 against the best single model's 74.1% at $500.
page_title: COMPASS: Routing via Capability-Oriented Model Profiling with Adaptive Search, Selection, and Tool Use

title: Pathwise-Budgeted LLM Routing: Online Allocation with K-Bit Tail-Cost Learning
one_line: Models the heavy tail of response cost and solves more than twice as many MATH500/GPQA tasks at the tightest budgets.
page_title: Pathwise-Budgeted LLM Routing: Online Allocation with K-Bit Tail-Cost Learning

title: Ensemble Routing for Prompt-Adaptive Cost-Aware LLM Inference (PISA)
one_line: At lower-cost operating points, cost falls about 36% in distribution and 25% out of distribution against the strongest ensemble baselines.
page_title: Ensemble Routing for Prompt-Adaptive Cost-Aware LLM Inference (PISA)

title: MultiTurnRoute: A Platform for Building and Evaluating Multi-Turn LLM Routers
one_line: Multi-turn routing benchmark; the CoR method cuts normalised cost to match the strongest model by up to 20.3%.
page_title: MultiTurnRoute: A Platform for Building and Evaluating Multi-Turn LLM Routers

title: CliffCompaction: Cost-Efficient Compaction for Long-Horizon Coding Agents
one_line: Drop-only compaction that never rewrites or re-compacts cuts cost by up to 50% under a bounded context.
page_title: CliffCompaction: Cost-Efficient Compaction for Long-Horizon Coding Agents

title: Beyond Token Savings: A Systematic Study of Context Compression in LLM Agents
one_line: About 35k runs show fewer tokens did not reliably mean cheaper or faster; some policies using a third of the tokens ran 20-80% slower.
page_title: Beyond Token Savings: A Systematic Study of Context Compression in LLM Agents

title: An Empirical Study of Harness Design for Coding Agents
one_line: Across 176 matched settings, rule-based elision beats LLM summarisation, and a bash-only interface lowers cost for bash-capable models.
page_title: An Empirical Study of Harness Design for Coding Agents

title: Total Cost of Agency: Exact Attribution of Memory Injection Cost in Multi-Agent Workflows
one_line: Memory injection is 13.6% of optimisable variable cost, rising to 27.6% at depth 6; shrinking the retrieval window removes 28.7% of injected tokens.
page_title: Total Cost of Agency: Exact Attribution of Memory Injection Cost in Multi-Agent Workflows

title: Identical Runs, Different Results: Benchmarking AI Coding Agents on Open-Weight Models
one_line: Run-to-run variance exceeded the gap between agent pairings; cost differed over 20x between two agents on one model, mostly from caching.
page_title: Identical Runs, Different Results: Benchmarking AI Coding Agents on Open-Weight Models

title: DeltaSelect: Affordable A/B Testing for Coding Agents
one_line: A fixed small task subset tracks full-benchmark results; 13 evaluations cost $27.86 and the adopted configuration cost 58.1% less.
page_title: DeltaSelect: Affordable A/B Testing for Coding Agents

title: Tools Need Not Speak in Text: Latent Context Compression for Agents (Coca-Cola)
one_line: Compresses tool observations into latent tokens injected into the agent's input embeddings; web-search agents use 70.01 to 89.24% fewer tokens and run 24.45 to 55.97% faster.
page_title: Tools Need Not Speak in Text: Latent Context Compression for Agents (Coca-Cola)

title: In-Model Context Compression with Agentic Soft Tokens for Long-Horizon LLM Agents (ASTC)
one_line: Training-free soft-token compression inside the agent; reduces later-layer compute and yields reusable KV caches. Needs a hybrid GDN-attention model.
page_title: In-Model Context Compression with Agentic Soft Tokens for Long-Horizon LLM Agents (ASTC)

title: Compress What You See, Not What You Say: Anchored Context Distillation for Latent-Observation Software Engineering Agents (LOHA/ACD)
one_line: Old tool observations become soft tokens while the last K stay text; trained on SWE-bench Verified with behaviour anchored to the base model.
page_title: Compress What You See, Not What You Say: Anchored Context Distillation for Latent-Observation Software Engineering Agents (LOHA/ACD)

title: ActKV: Efficient LLM Agents through Action-Guided KV Cache Management
one_line: KV-cache eviction valued by contribution to action generation; serving-side, needs control of the inference engine.
page_title: ActKV: Efficient LLM Agents through Action-Guided KV Cache Management

title: TokenEconomizer: Experience-Driven Black-Box Cost Control for Coding Agents
one_line: Black-box controller that prunes tool schemas and interrupts failure loops; token cost down 18.4 to 30.9% on Claude Code, Codex and Copilot CLI at comparable success.
page_title: TokenEconomizer: Experience-Driven Black-Box Cost Control for Coding Agents
